setup.title: Set up two-factor login
setup.intro: Every user must use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. It shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
setup.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with the app
setup.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:
setup.step2: 2. Enter the code the app shows
setup.codesIntro: If you lose your phone you can log in with one of these codes. Each code works once. Print them or store them in a password manager. They are shown only now.

audit.intro: Every change, login and download. The log can only be added to, never changed or deleted, and each event is chained to the previous one with a checksum.

audit.verifyBad: WARNING: The log was changed outside the system from event #{seq}. Contact your accountant and restore from backup.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: The system stores only the personal data needed to run the company and keep the books: users' names and emails, login history (time, IP address and browser) and, later, contact details of customers and suppliers.
privacy.p2: The database and documents are stored encrypted in the EU (Frankfurt and Cloudflare EU storage). Backups are stored encrypted with another provider in the EU. The website runs on Netlify, so requests may be processed in the USA.
privacy.p3: You can download everything stored about you under "My account". The owner can anonymise former users. Accounting records must still be kept as long as the Bookkeeping Act requires, and the audit log is never changed.
privacy.p4: Questions about privacy go to the company owner.

help.title: User guide
help.intro: A short guide to what is in the system now. It grows with each phase.
help.s1: Log in with email and password, or with Google. After that you always enter a 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone. After 2 hours without activity, or at most 12 hours, you are logged out automatically.
help.s2: Use one of the recovery codes you saved when setting up the app. If you do not have them either, the owner can reset your two-factor login under "Users". You then set up the app again at next login.
help.s3: Owner: everything, including users and settings. Employee: record and change data. Accountant: see everything and download, but change nothing. Everyone can download exports.
help.s4: The owner invites people under "Users". The invitee gets an email with a link that works for 7 days and only once.
help.s5: Every change is logged with who, when and what. The log cannot be changed. Press "Verify the log" to check that nobody has changed it directly in the database.
help.s6: The database and documents are copied, encrypted, every night to a separate storage service. Every week a restore is tested automatically. See the README for setup.
